senses.gloss:
m. (-मः)
A dramatic entertainment, dramatic exhibition of battle or siege, such as the Tripuradāha, in which the destruction of the three cities of TRIPURA by ŚIVA is dramatised.
E.
डिम्ब affray, &c. deriv. irr.

m. (-म्बः)
1 Affray, assault, conflict without weapons, mutual defiance, petty and predatory war, &c. see डमर.
2 Sound or noise occasioned by terror.
3 An egg.
4 A chrysalis.
5 The bladder.
6 The spleen.
7 The uterus.
8 Fear, terror.
9 Any young animal.
10 A globe or ball.
E.
डी to fly, derive irr.

m. (-वः)
Petty warfare, affray, skirmish, riot, &c.
E.
डिम्ब as above, and आहव war, battle; also डिम्बयुद्ध, and other similar compounds.

f. (-का)
1 A bubble.
2 A kind of waterfly.
3 A libidinous woman.
E.
डिम्ब the bladder, &c. कन् aff.

m. (-म्भः)
1 Any young animal.
2 A fool, an idiot, a blockhead.
f. (-म्भा)
An infant.
E.
डिभि to collect, affix अच्; कन् being added; also डिम्भक.

n. (-क्रं)
A diagram for telling fortunes.
